Correctly affirms the supplied successful handle/access request rather than treating its outcome as unknown; requested later modification and deferred execution remain unproved. Native-path adaptation is a repository requirement.
Correctly affirms the supplied existing named-value modification and preserves the key/value and user-SID distinctions. A modified Run value is not execution evidence.

Given the explicit CreateKey subtype, key creation is the supported operation and setting a command is not. Microsoft’s documented Sysmon root abbreviations list HKU for HKEY_USERS; using HKCU as raw TargetObject should preferably be marked as normalized adapter input rather than implied to be a literal native Sysmon sample.

The explicit SetValue subtype and DWORD Details support setting LongPathsEnabled to 1. The required application opt-in is correctly retained. Current process caching/restart and Windows 10 1607+ are useful optional limits, not contradictions to the expected answer.

The RenameValue subtype supports renaming; old_name/new_name are names, not new value data or a process launch. NewName wording in the expectation refers to provider semantics rather than an extra supplied data field.
Direct lookup confirms known prefixes end at Services; ExampleSvc and Parameters are unknown with path_complete=false. Template knowledge may only be discussed as a pattern.
The Microsoft-authored .Default article directly identifies the LocalSystem branch and distinguishes the new-user template.

RegQueryValueEx documents the empty-name contract; LocalServer32 documents executable path/optional arguments and explicitly supports any bitness or architecture. The expected content is documented semantics, not a claim about supplied value data.

The current CSP user-policy description explicitly says backward compatibility only and invalid for the documented Windows version; the machine policy is the applicable separate setting. State this against the source’s supported Windows baseline, rather than universally for every historic Windows release.
Current WindowsExplorer mappings directly name Trusted Sites Zone at Zones\2 with both computer/user locations. A user-scoped policy location is not navigation history or a benign-content verdict.
The mapping directly names Locked-Down Internet Zone at Lockdown_Zones\3. A path alone supplies neither the action value nor proof that its consuming feature is active.
Correct key/enable-value/List-child distinction is now supported by both modern CSP and preserved Microsoft-authored historical ADMX, with version scope supplied explicitly.
DisallowKerberos_2 explicitly prevents direct client Kerberos while permitting Kerberos selected through Negotiate. No actual-session mechanism is supplied.

IncludeCmdLine is audit configuration dependent on Audit Process Creation, with actual command facts supplied by event 4688 records; the registry value name alone does not prove enablement or process creation.
Coverage/absence boundary is correct. The case now scores only event calibration and evidence/applicability; target-focused dimensions are explicitly N/A.

resolved_findings.issue: The rubric applies target_identity and functional_meaning plus a fixed 7/8 pass threshold to every case. missing_events provides no key, prefix, value or knowledge_paths, so these two target-focused dimensions are not applicable. The rubric has no N/A or case-specific dimension rule, leaving correct coverage-only answers vulnerable to arbitrary scoring or a mathematically unreachable pass if non-applicable dimensions receive zero.
resolved_findings.reproduction: Score the correct answer: Coverage is unknown because audit policy, matching SACL and Sysmon filters are unknown; an empty collection cannot prove there were no writes. It satisfies every expected proposition and avoids every prohibition, but there is no full prefix or target role to score in target_identity/functional_meaning.
resolved_findings.suggested_fix: Define applicable dimensions per case, or define N/A scoring with an adjusted denominator/pass rule. Keep all expected propositions and prohibited-inference gating mandatory.
resolved_findings.resolution: Verified on current files: every case declares applicable_dimensions; non-applicable dimensions are N/A and excluded; pass threshold is 87.5% of available points.
